sources.fact: Authoritative Brownfield entity LBBD56 identifies Sugden Way on 0.12ha.
The record starts and enters on 31 December 2017 and has no stated end date.
The Brownfield record does not state minimum or maximum net dwellings.
Ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this is a category, not current proprietor/title proof.
The record supplies a point and no exact Brownfield/title polygon.
November 2018 Planning Committee considered 18/00777/FUL at the former garage site, Sugden Way.
The exact proposal comprised 13 flats: one one-bedroom, eight two-bedroom and four three-bedroom units.
All 13 units were intended for social rent; tenure does not create additional capacity.
The Committee granted planning permission subject to conditions.
The 2016 infill decision treated Sugden Way as a temporary-housing site subject to feasibility and planning; strategy is not the 2018 permission itself.
The not-permissioned Brownfield field and 2018 Committee grant remain an unresolved current-status conflict without issued-notice/title readback.

examples.result: LBBD56 retains a structured not-permissioned status.
The authoritative Brownfield record has no stated dwelling capacity.
The 13 homes are not inserted silently into the blank Brownfield capacity fields.
Committee grant and current structured status remain visibly conflicted.
Social-rent tenure does not add dwelling capacity.
Public-authority category and point are not proprietor/title topology.
Promotion remains zero until current permission finality, completion state and title relation are verified.
